noise_method: heteroskedastic Gaussian noise from each reference candidate uncertainty, plus zero-mean correlated AR(1)-like systematic field scaled locally by empirical uncertainty
external_holdout: HAT-P-1b remains evaluation-only and is not included.
limitations: Published transmission spectra are observational reference candidates, not analytical ground truth.
The corpus mixes instruments and reductions; this is intentional domain diversity but is not a homogeneous instrument model.
Synthetic noise is a statistical observation proxy, not a detector-level simulator.
No new atmospheric features are added.
